name: Dry Hair
description: Dry hair is characterized by a lack of moisture and often appears brittle, frizzy, and prone to breakage. It lacks the natural oils that keep the strands hydrated and healthy.
common_problems: Crackling sound when running fingers through hair
Difficulty styling due to frizz and dryness
recommended_ingredients: Moisture-rich oils (e.g., argan oil, coconut oil)
washing_frequency: Every other day or every third day to avoid stripping natural oils
oil_recommendation: Regular use of hair oils can help lock in moisture. Apply a small amount on damp hair and style as usual.

morning_routine.action: Apply a hydrating leave-in conditioner or serum to damp hair
morning_routine.purpose: To keep hair moisturized throughout the day

night_routine.action: Deep condition your hair using a mask or intensive treatment at least once a week
night_routine.purpose: To replenish moisture and strengthen strands

weekly_care: Use a heat protectant before applying any heat styling tools to avoid further damage
deep_conditioning_frequency: Once a week or as needed based on hair condition
heat_styling_recommendation: Limit the use of heat styling tools and always apply heat protectants. Consider air-drying your hair when possible.
lifestyle_tips: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water daily
Eat a balanced diet rich in vitamins and minerals that support healthy hair growth
common_mistakes: Using harsh products that can strip natural oils
do: Regularly deep condition to keep strands moisturized
Use a wide-tooth comb or fingers to detangle
dont: Rely on heavy styling products that can weigh down dry hair

seasonal_care.summer: Use lighter, oil-free products to avoid greasiness. Protect hair from sun exposure by wearing a hat or using a UV-protective spray.
seasonal_care.winter: Focus on deep conditioning and use richer, more nourishing products to combat dry winter air.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Increase the frequency of deep conditionings to counteract moisture loss due to humidity.

compatible_hair_types: Oily hair (when using appropriate balancing products)
expert_tips: Regular trims can help prevent split ends and keep dry, damaged hair manageable.
Consider a humidifier in your home or office to add moisture back into the air during dry winter months.
